title: Did a Hidden Mountain Sink the Edmund Fitzgerald?
checks: Any readable text, letters, numbers, ship names or signs. The Fitzgerald's name must not appear anywhere.
Modern things in a 1902 or 1918 picture, or 1980s and later things in a 1975 picture.
Ships that look wrong: the 1970s freighter must be very long, with the pilothouse at the very front and the funnel at the very back.
Faces shown close up. People should be small, far away or seen from behind.
Warped hands, extra limbs, or bodies that look wrong.
Anyone shown drowning, injured or dead, or any human remains in the underwater wreck pictures.
thumbText: Make all three. I will add the text "21 FEET" between the hull and the peak, and we will pick the one that reads best at phone size.
